Kit summary

Primordial SpiritBasic
Selects an enemy and inflicts [Primordial Seed] on them according to their HP percentage: 0%-25%: 1 layer 25%-50%: 2 layers 50%-75%: 3 layers 75%-100%: 4 layers Afterward, deals 380% ATK DMG to the target, for every 1 layer of [Primordial Seed] owned, increases the DMG by 5%. If the target is under [Deconstruction] status, increases the DMG by 75% instead.
Darkness TorrentActive
Deals 2 stages of 130% ATK DMG each to all enemies. If the target has [DEF Down I] or [DEF Down II], each stage deals 325% ATK DMG to the target instead; if not, there is a 100% chance to reduce the target's DEF by 60% for 2 turns instead.
Primordial ForcePassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
When an enemy restores 14% of their Max HP in total, Madlaina inflicts 1 layer of [Primordial Seed] on them. If 15 layers of [Primordial Seed] are stacked, Madlaina cleanses all control effects from self. Meanwhile, she consumes 10 layers of [Primordial Seed] and crumbles the target: if the target's HP is lower than 50%, she slays the target directly; if not or she fails to slay the target, deals 1000% ATK DMG to the target and inflicts [Deconstruction] on them; this DMG is considered as Basic Attack DMG. [Deconstruction]: Reduces the owner's DEF by 60%. This effect cannot be cleansed or blocked, and is regarded as DEF Down, Attribute Debuff, and Debuff.
Gate of Eternal Silence Lv.1Madlaina has extra Direct DMG Reduction effect, 20% at least, and 50% at most. The more the allies survive, the higher the effect. When any ally dies, increases Madlaina's Max HP by 15% (up to 60%) and Turn Meter by 25%; meanwhile, restores her HP by 25% of self Max HP. The Max HP bonus effect will not be removed when she dies or at the wave transition.
Gate of Eternal Silence Lv.2When any enemy inflicts a kill, if Madlaina survives, she will cleanse all control effects from self immediately and crumbles (according to Primordial Force) the target for once.
Spirit ParadeActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 3 stages of 150% ATK DMG each to all enemies, and inflicts 1 layer of [Primordial Seed]. For every 1 layer of [Primordial Seed] owned by the target, increases the DMG by 4%. If the target is under [Deconstruction] status, increases the DMG by 60% instead.
Gate of Eternal Silence Lv.3When any enemy dies, reduces the CD of Spirit Parade by 1 turn. Additionally, Spirit Parade has extra 35% Piercing rate against the target with 5 layers of [Primordial Seed] or under [Deconstruction] status. Increases the DMG bonus of each layer to 8% for the target with 10 layers of [Primordial Seed] or under [Deconstruction] status.
